rows.grounds: fused form with internal sandhi joining attainment-of-siddhis and root-kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching regarding the attainment of powers?
premises: Eight powers are named as attained.
The attainment of these powers is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis is equated with the root Kaula doctrine.
uncertainties: The exact internal analysis of the fused compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
